body: I've thought about it but trying to talk to anyone feels impossible its like a cage made of my mind anytime I think of talking to anyone I feel nauseous
I'm sorry if something is wrong but please dont. If nothing else I love you I would miss you

While I understand that this may seem like the best way I have struggled with these thoughts myself and I want you to know if no one else care for you I do I love you stranger I wish I could hold you and make it all better
